import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import time
import warnings
from collections import defaultdict
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
start_time = time.time()
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Create ID columns
train_df["id"] = (
    train_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)
test_df["id"] = (
    test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)

print("\nExploring data...")
class_counts = train_df["class"].value_counts().sort_index()
print(f"Train 'class' unique: {train_df['class'].nunique()}")
print(f"Train 'class' value counts:\n{class_counts.head(10)}")
print(f"Train 'after' unique: {train_df['after'].nunique()}")

print("\nBuilding class-based prediction model...")

# Encode class as integer for efficient lookup
class_to_idx = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(sorted(train_df["class"].unique()))}
idx_to_class = {idx: cls for cls, idx in class_to_idx.items()}

# Build efficient mappings using groupby (vectorized)
print("Constructing class mappings...")
class_mappings = defaultdict(dict)
class_counts_after = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))

for cls in sorted(train_df["class"].unique()):
    cls_subset = train_df[train_df["class"] == cls]
    for before_val, group in cls_subset.groupby("before"):
        after_counts = group["after"].value_counts()
        most_common = after_counts.index[0] if len(after_counts) > 0 else None
        class_counts_after[cls][before_val] += 1
        if most_common:
            class_mappings[cls][before_val] = most_common

print(f"Class mappings created for {len(class_mappings)} classes")
print(
    f"Average mappings per class: {sum(len(m) for m in class_mappings.values()) / len(class_mappings):.1f}"
)

print("\nValidating on hold-out validation set...")
train_val_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["class"]
)
train_df = train_val_df

# Compute most common 'after' per class for fallback
class_fallback = {}
for cls in class_mappings:
    cls_data = train_df[train_df["class"] == cls]
    most_common = (
        cls_data["after"].value_counts().index[0] if len(cls_data) > 0 else None
    )
    class_fallback[cls] = most_common

val_predictions = []
for _, row in val_df.iterrows():
    cls = row["class"]
    before = str(row["before"]) if pd.notna(row["before"]) else ""

    if cls in class_mappings and before in class_mappings[cls]:
        pred = class_mappings[cls][before]
    else:
        pred = class_fallback.get(
            cls, "<self>" if before == "<self>" or pd.isna(row["before"]) else "."
        )

    val_predictions.append(pred)

# Merge predictions with actual for validation accuracy
val_actual_df = val_df[["sentence_id", "token_id", "after", "class"]].copy()
val_actual_df["id"] = (
    val_actual_df["sentence_id"].astype(str)
    + "_"
    + val_actual_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)
val_actual_df["pred"] = val_predictions
val_acc_df = val_actual_df[["id", "after", "pred"]]
val_acc_df = val_acc_df.rename(columns={"after": "actual", "pred": "pred"})
val_correct = (val_acc_df["actual"] == val_acc_df["pred"]).astype(int)
val_accuracy = val_correct.mean()
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_predictions = []
for _, row in test_df.iterrows():
    before = str(row["before"]) if pd.notna(row["before"]) else ""

    # Direct lookup
    pred = None
    for cls in sorted(class_mappings):
        if before in class_mappings[cls]:
            pred = class_mappings[cls][before]
            break

    # Fallback
    if pred is None:
        if before == "<self>" or pd.isna(row["before"]):
            pred = "<self>"
        elif before in [".", ",", ";", ":", "?", "!"]:
            pred = before
        elif before in ["—", "-", "…"]:
            pred = before
        elif any(c.isdigit() for c in before):
            pred = before
        elif any(c.isalpha() for c in before):
            pred = before
        elif before == "":
            pred = "."
        else:
            pred = "<self>"

    test_predictions.append(pred)

print("Saving submission file...")
test_pred_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "after": test_predictions})
test_pred_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"\n=== FINAL SUMMARY ===")
print(f"Training rows: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Validation rows: {len(val_df)}")
print(f"Test rows: {len(test_df)}")
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
print(f"Elapsed time: {elapsed_time:.2f} seconds")
print(f"Submission file: ./submission/submission.csv ({len(test_predictions)} rows)")
